name: "Ruinwake | Anarchy Survival"
description:
# RUINWAKE | JAVA & BEDROCK ANARCHY

Welcome to **Ruinwake**, a persistent Minecraft anarchy server inspired by 2b2t, where Java and Bedrock players share the same world.

No land claims. No protected bases. No economy. No unnecessary rules.

Build massive bases, form alliances, establish settlements, wage wars, raid enemy territory, or survive entirely on your own. PvP, griefing, and base raiding are allowed. Trust is earned, betrayal is expected, and nothing you build is guaranteed to survive.

Ruinwake is built around a **permanent survival world with no planned resets**. Every abandoned fortress, destroyed base, hidden stash, and battlefield becomes part of the server's history. What players create and destroy today will shape the world for years to come.

There are no artificial advantages, paid kits, land protections, or economy systems. Your survival depends on your decisions, preparation, and ability to outlast everyone else.

## SERVER FEATURES

- **Java & Bedrock Crossplay** — Both editions share one persistent world.

- **Hard Survival Difficulty** — Survival is meant to be challenging.

- **PvP, Raiding & Griefing** — Combat and destruction are part of the experience.

- **No Land Claims** — No protected bases or safe territories.

- **No Kits or Economy** — Items and resources must be earned through gameplay.

- **No Pay-to-Win** — No purchased gameplay advantages.

- **16-Chunk View Distance** — Explore and build across a larger visible world.

- **Permanent World** — No planned map resets.

- **Player Statistics & Leaderboards** — Track playtime, kills, deaths, and other achievements.

- **Anti-Cheat Protection** — GrimAC and GhostAC help detect unfair gameplay advantages.

- **Automatic World Backups** — Regular backups help protect the world's history.

- **24/7 Dedicated Hosting** — Hosted on dedicated server hardware.
